svg.aria-label: A coin-feed escapement on a bed. Tokens, one per call to lock(), stack in a column of three rods: the queue. A crank drives a pusher blade exactly one token thick, so it carries one token at a time to a press and over the end into a bin. While the blade is out, the next token rests on it; when it retracts, the next token drops in.
svg.title: superlock mutex
